data.exact_reserve_text: As a result of the settlements made and the uncertainty of outcomes, we have increased our loss reserves by a further GBP 128.9m gross and GBP 29.3m net of reinsurance recoveries. The updates have resulted in ultimate gross reserves of GBP 393.4m, GBP 113.8m net of reinsurance (31 December 2023 - GBP 264.5m gross, GBP 84.5m net of reinsurance) as at 31 December 2024.

Gross and net losses of GBP 29.0m and GBP 10.0m respectively contributing to gross and net loss ratios; across Property Reinsurance, Non Marine Direct & Facultative, Property Direct USA and Cargo Fine Art & Specie classes.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2024 the syndicate recorded material adverse prior year reserve development, driven chiefly by geopolitical-related aviation exposures (western-leased aircraft in Russia) and deterioration on legacy US contractors liability (Florida construction defect claims). The managing agent increased gross reserves (notably a GBP 128.9m uplift linked to the Russian aviation position) and recorded other adverse movements, resulting in a net gross prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 194.6m (about 15.2% of opening gross reserves). The year also experienced substantial 2024 large losses (the Dali bridge collapse and several hurricanes) which impacted current-year claims and reserves across Marine, Energy and Property lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross figure was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (cumulative ultimate estimates) by summing diagonal movements for underwriting years 2015-2022 (triangle values are presented in GBP '000). The narrative and movement notes explicitly cite gross increases for specific items (e.g. Russia aviation +GBP 128.9m; Florida contractors +GBP 52.7m) which are consistent with the triangle but do not fully reconcile to the triangle total (triangle aggregate PYD = GBP 194.623m). RITC transactions were checked; an LPT occurred post-balance (Jan 2025) and does not distort the 31 Dec 2024 triangle. Where line-of-business allocations were not explicitly quantified in the report, amounts are left null and confidence reduced accordingly.
